hypotheses.claim: cnGUINanocom.Update dispatches actions 14,15,16,17,22,23,4 in exclusive priority outside tutorial and after menu sliding. OnStatus and OnNanoBook share equipment mode with different initial tabs.
CnEquip.Update closes the active I/N tab through event 11/13 and switches the other tab; cnMissionJournal.Update closes on action16 and cnHelpMode.UpdateHelp on action19.
Panel_EmailList supports GuideNpcNum [707,728,731,732,1171] and all five mentor mail columns; Computress Future (raw guide 5) must not block Email entry.
EmailMode.Update reads configurable action4 for Escape and action17 only while NewEmail is disabled. Email open/close readers need deterministic native ordering.

cnAvatarAttack action13 sends CHARGE_NANO_STAMINA with the local PC ID when an active Nano and battery exist. GameCondition cooldown5 is one second, checked before battery. ReceiveNanoStaminaChange updates bank stamina and battery and plays Nano_Potion.

differences.detail: Native opening readers for I/N/J/P/H were absent; map input explicitly bypassed configurable mappings.
Existing physical Escape remains accepted for map/journal/help; original configurable action4 defaults to backquote. Existing native panel gates and server authority remain in place.
Email guide projection accepted only selectable mentors 1..4; raw mentor5 prevented the production mode from opening even with an empty inbox.
Mail P close ignored Compose ownership, configured Escape was absent, and router/Email close ordering was unspecified.
World Nano charge key13 had no request/reply owner. Combat Fire1/Fire2/WeaponChange and world Nano1/2/3 bypassed committed option mappings.

conclusion: The P regression is fixed at the production boundary: GuideRawMentor::ComputressFuture resolves the fifth message column and NPC1171. The native router runs before Email close input; configurable action4 closes mail, and action17 does not close Compose. Committed keyboard/mouse mappings feed combat and world Nano slot actions. Action13 now sends the clean one-second charge request; the exact reply updates owned bank stamina, equipped stamina, battery and Nano_Potion. Thirteen targeted tests pass, including repeated production Email entry/exit for every mentor, native catalog inventory projection and Future guide text. Development build and native schedule startup pass. These results cover keyboard/lifecycle/packet behavior; no full visual parity or live shard exchange is claimed.

nativeContract.input: Physical keys through committed InputSettings primary/alternate mappings; no localized text used as identity.
nativeContract.ownership: Shortcuts precede option/map/quit and UI input. Existing typed mode actions and inventory close reducer own mutations and packet arbitration. Email routing precedes its production close reader. C sends a bounded request; bank/stamina/battery and Nano_Potion commit only on the exact authoritative reply.
